requirements.summary: Canonical router routeNativeTurn is the only semantic routing entry; managed run and native chat share it (AC-01)
RouteCapsule carries route_id/generation/idempotency, hashes, selected skills+integrations, materialized context, proof selection, six-status semantics
One route per (host, session, turn, prompt hash, generation); compaction/retry/tool events reuse the capsule
Raw prompt stays in canonical WorkRequest/TaskPacket only; external receipts hash, never duplicate
CLI transport route-native --stdin: capsule JSON to stdout, diagnostics to stderr, no shell interpolation of prompt
OMP bootstrap gate: router called once, correct skill, correct hashes, context hash before model request, canary nonce returned
Dogfood: every post-bootstrap slice routes implicitly through installed global OMP adapter with full receipt
Each remaining host gets thin adapter or honest UNSUPPORTED with evidence; provider never decides host adapter

MCP PASS only with observed call chain registered -> selected -> called -> success/effect; login-required provider = NEEDS_USER not host failure
Closure: no drift, projections rebuilt from canonical source, full gates green, independent read-only review, OutcomeReceipt
